items.title: EU to condemn war in Ukraine at G20 even if Putin attends
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has been invited to the G20 summit in Miami by the United States. Multiple members of the group have called for Moscow's exclusion over its invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
items.description: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.
